title: Illinois's 13th Congressional District general election, 2026
description: The general election for Illinois's 13th Congressional District features Democratic incumbent Nikki Budzinski, first elected in 2022, against Republican challenger Jeff Wilson, a Champaign County Board member. The district stretches from Champaign-Urbana southwest through Springfield and Decatur to the Metro East suburbs of St. Louis. Created as a Democratic-leaning seat after the 2021 redistricting, it carries a Cook PVI of D+5, and Budzinski won her 2024 race by 16 points. Budzinski emphasizes affordability and protecting the middle class, while Wilson campaigns on border security, lowering costs, and supporting President Trump's America First agenda.
polling_note: No publicly available general election polls were found for this race as of June 2026.

candidates.name: Nikki Budzinski
candidates.summary: Nikki Budzinski is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Illinois's 13th District, first elected in 2022. She previously served as chief of staff at the White House Office of Management and Budget and as a senior advisor to Illinois Governor J.B. Pritzker, and spent much of her career as a labor union official. She serves on the House Agriculture and Veterans' Affairs Committees and is a member of the moderate New Democrat Coalition.

candidates.name: Jeff Wilson
candidates.summary: Jeff Wilson is a Republican running for U.S. House in Illinois's 13th District. He is a U.S. Navy veteran who served as a crew member on a nuclear-powered submarine, a retired nuclear engineer with a master's degree from the University of Illinois, and is currently serving his second term on the Champaign County Board. Wilson campaigns on supporting President Trump's America First policies, focusing on border security, lowering costs through energy production and deregulation, and opposing what he views as overreach by federal law enforcement restrictions.

forecast.rationale: No public general-election polling is available for this race, so confidence is limited and the forecast relies on structural factors from the provided race data. Illinois's 13th District has a Cook PVI of D+5, providing a Democratic baseline advantage. Incumbent Nikki Budzinski has won two elections, including a 16-point victory in 2024, demonstrating strong personal vote share above the district's baseline. Republican challenger Jeff Wilson is a credible candidate with county board service, military background, and a degree from UIUC, and is running on Trump-aligned themes. However, in a D+5 district with an entrenched incumbent who has overperformed the baseline, Democrats hold a clear but not overwhelming advantage. Without polling, the forecast is structurally grounded and moderately confident.
